# misra

> Daily batch pipeline that crawls career pages, keeps its history in Supabase, and emails job alerts. Runs on GitHub Actions; there is no server or API. The only UI is a static dashboard.

## Project

- [Dashboard](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/): Open entry-level, student and product roles in Israel, read daily from company career pages; the search field gives the live company count and the Coverage gaps card lists the companies whose roles may be missing or old.
- [About](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/about.html): What Misra is, where the roles come from, how often they are read, what it does not do, job alerts and the assistant, for people who use the dashboard.
- [Contact](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/contact.html): How to reach the maintainer: GitHub issues for questions and bugs, the security note for vulnerabilities, the privacy notice for your data.
- [Connect your assistant](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/assistant.html): How to add the read-only Misra job search to Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant (MCP, no sign-in).
- [Overview and quickstart](/README.md): Pipeline commands, the daily run, the dashboard and development setup.
- [Changelog](/CHANGELOG.md): Released changes.

## Policies and support

- [Security](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/security.html): Vulnerability reporting and supported versions.
- [Privacy](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/privacy.html): Data-handling policy.
- [Terms](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/terms.html): The as-is terms of use.
- [Support](/SUPPORT.md): Where to ask, and troubleshooting.

- [Design system](/design-system/README.md): Tokens, components, logo brief, and the WebMCP tools the dashboard exposes.
